entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Would you really forgive[n]someone unconditionally if[n]you owe your life to them?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not so sure anymore.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you bringing this up for?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: According to Kitagawa-kun,[n]Madarame isn't a problem.
What do you mean?
Is something wrong?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Something wrong?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, a little.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, I know Madarame is a[n]bad person, but still...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe I'm so hesitant because[n]I haven't actually met any of[n]his victims.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I guess that part's[n]totally different from what[n]happened with Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This might be an extreme[n]line of thinking...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But if an evil person isn't[n]causing any trouble now...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is there really a point[n]in us stepping in?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well... you got a point.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So we're gonna let Yusuke[n]decide if Madarame's worth[n]going after or not?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno... If it were me, I'd[n]never forgive that bastard!
Let's see how Yusuke feels.
Can you ask Yusuke, Ann?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah... I guess we could[n]talk some more after that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kk, got it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess we can talk some more[n]about this after that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: OK. Let's meet in Shibuya[n]after school tomorrow.
